title: Unit
description: Canonical definition of a Heroes.Battle unit consumed by the engine. Mirrors the data the hardcoded UnitBase subclasses (Pikeman, Griffin, Centaur, Elf) expose: a name, a static UnitStateLine (Initiative/Speed/HitPoints/DamageMin/DamageMax/Attack/Defence), an attack pattern, a CanFly flag, plus the new level (1-7) and optional imagePath. Runtime state (Wounds, CounterAttacks, MovementLeft, LongEffects) is NOT part of the unit definition — it is initialized by the engine.

name.description: Display name of the unit (Pikeman, Griffin, Centaur, …). Surfaced in event payloads (UnitActivated, DamageDealt, …) and used as the unit's identity in the renderer.

level.description: Castle/Rampart-style tier from 1 (weakest) to 7 (strongest). New field — drives recruitment cost tables, dwelling layout, and AI valuation downstream.

faction.description: Faction the unit belongs to. Mirrors the existing namespace split (Heroes.Battle.Units.Army.Castle / Heroes.Battle.Units.Army.Rampart). Optional — orphan units load without a faction.

canFly.description: Whether the unit can fly over obstacles. Engine default is false; only Griffin overrides to true (UnitBase.CanFly). Optional — omit for ground-bound units.

counterAttacks.description: Maximum counter-attacks per round. UnitBase.CounterAttacks defaults to 1 and decrements on each CounterAttack call. Optional — omit to inherit the engine default.

attackPattern.description: Attack pattern the unit uses. 'Melee' = MeleeAttackPattern (Pikeman, Griffin, Centaur). 'Distance' = DistanceAttackPattern (Elf) — automatically falls back to CloseDistanceAttackPattern with halved damage when an enemy is adjacent.

stateLine.description: Static UnitStateLine — the seven combat stats on Heroes.Core.Units.Army.UnitStateLine. All values are non-negative integers. Damage range is inclusive on both ends and damageMin must not exceed damageMax.

initiative.description: Turn-order weight used by the InitiativeTracker.

speed.description: Cells the unit can move per round. Copied to MovementLeft on Activate.

hitPoints.description: Maximum hit points. Wounds accumulate against this value; unit dies when Wounds ≥ HitPoints (UnitExtensions.IsDead).

damageMin.description: Lower bound of the damage roll passed to RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32 (inclusive).

damageMax.description: Upper bound of the damage roll (inclusive). Must be ≥ damageMin.

attack.description: Attack stat. (attack - defenderDefence) > 0 multiplies the rolled damage by 1.1 per point of difference (AttackPatternBase.CalculateDamage).

defence.description: Defence stat. Mitigates incoming attack via the same difference rule.

imagePath.description: Relative path of the unit's image asset, resolved through D9bolic.Assets IImageStore. Populated in T8 — units may omit this field until image assets are wired up.
